ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Office Document Executed From Trusted Location
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of an Office application that points to a document that is located in a trusted location. Attackers often used this to avoid macro security and execute their malicious code.

sequences.query: ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\explorer\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\dopus\\\.exe$")) AND ((process_path = RGX("\\\\EXCEL\\\.EXE$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\POWERPNT\\\.EXE$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\WINWORD\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "Excel\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "POWERPNT\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "WinWord\.exe")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\Microsoft\\\\Templates.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\Microsoft\\\\Word\\\\Startup\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\ Office\\\\root\\\\Templates\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\ Office\\\\Templates\\\\.*"))) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dotx$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.xltx$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.potx$")))
